preconditions.description: The number of employees n and teams k are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t_i <= k for t_i in t)
preconditions.description: Each team number t_i is between 1 and k, inclusive.
The input list t contains exactly n team numbers.

preconditions.expression: all(any(t_i == team for t_i in t) for team in range(1, k + 1))
preconditions.description: Every team from 1 to k has at least one employee.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum cost.
The output is the minimum cost of renting a bus, where min_cost is the smallest possible value of s * r such that all employees can be transported under the given constraints.

postconditions.expression: min_cost == min(sum(team_sizes) * r for r in possible_rides for s in possible_sizes if feasible(r, s, team_sizes))
postconditions.description: The minimum cost is computed by considering all feasible combinations of rides (r) and bus capacities (s), where feasible(r, s, team_sizes) is true if all employees can be transported in r rides with bus capacity s, adhering to the rules that a ride can carry one or two teams, and no ride can carry more than s people.

postconditions.expression: feasible(r, s, team_sizes) == all(sum(team_sizes for team in ride) <= s for ride in rides) and all(len(ride) <= 2 for ride in rides)
postconditions.description: A combination of rides and capacity is feasible if every ride carries at most s people and each ride carries one or two teams.
